name: tgs-outreach-crm
description: Multi-channel outreach CRM for LinkedIn, email and cold calling

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev:server" "npm run dev:client"
scripts.build:all: npm --prefix server install --omit=dev && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build
